svg.data-port-modes-qsfp: 20G uplink - the datasheet says '20G QSFP+ Uplink' and nothing about the optics or modes behind it
svg.data-optics-sfp: 1G CSFP (two bidirectional fibre ports per module); 1000BASE-SX/LX/LHX/ZX; DDM
svg.data-port-summary: 24 CSFP cages (48 x 1G BiDi fibre), 4 x RJ-45 combo, 4 x 10G SFP+, 2 x 20G QSFP+
svg.data-mgmt-ports: 1x RJ-45 console, 1x RJ-45 GE out-of-band management
